mnemonic.description: The slot whose counters are read. Absent means the hosting service's server-wide aggregate, which only an administrator may read.

domain.description: Disambiguates `mnemonic` per the category conventions. Absent means the domain is resolved by the category's chain. MUST NOT be present without `mnemonic`: this task has no per-domain aggregate (did-management/stats/timeseries does).

mnemonic.description: Echo of the slot read. Absent on the server-wide aggregate.

totalDids.description: Slots the hosting service holds. Present only on the server-wide aggregate.

lastResolvedAt.description: Absent when the scope has never been resolved.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Absent when the scope has never been updated.
